reglages.stockage.garderReunionsAide: After that, transcript, notes and summary are deleted when Kobi starts.
reglages.stockage.garderConversationsAid: Your everyday chats with Kobi, kept apart from meetings.
reglages.stockage.publicationAide: Copies a summary to a tool (Linear, Notion…), with the Notebook’s “Publish” button.

reglages.animations.toujoursDetail: Kobi always moves, whatever the Windows setting.
reglages.animations.systemeDetailReduit: Windows has turned off its animation effects: Kobi would stay still.
reglages.animations.systemeDetail: Windows animates its windows: so does Kobi.
reglages.animations.reduitesDetail: Kobi keeps its expressions, without movement.
reglages.animations.fps5: The lightest: movement goes in small steps.
reglages.animations.fpsEcran: As many frames as the screen shows.
reglages.animations.fpsAide: Everything that moves follows this number: the mascot, its bubbles, the large conversation and the app.
reglages.animations.economieAide: When idle for a long time, Kobi slows down to 3 then 2 frames per second to save battery. Movement gets choppy.
reglages.animations.modeAide: The mascot, its bubbles and the text. The change applies right away, in every window.
reglages.affichage.verbositeAide: How long its answers are, how much the voice reads out, and its announcements.
reglages.affichage.verbositeNormalDetail: One or two sentences, details when you ask.
reglages.affichage.verbositeDiscretDetai: One sentence, and no announcement when a task takes long.
reglages.affichage.verbositeBavardDetail: Fuller answers, and the voice reads more of them.
reglages.affichage.modeAide: What Kobi shows next to itself on the desktop.
reglages.affichage.modeSimpleDetail: Kobi and a short bubble of three lines at most; the rest is read in the large view.
reglages.affichage.modeDetailleDetail: The bubble grows with the answer and scrolls.
reglages.affichage.autoAide: You can also open it by clicking the bubble, by saying “Kobi, show it large” or with Ctrl+Alt+G.
reglages.affichage.autoJamaisDetail: Only when I ask: nothing opens while you’re doing something else.
reglages.affichage.autoLonguesDetail: As soon as the bubble can’t show everything.
reglages.affichage.tailleAide: The width and height of the reading panel.
reglages.affichage.positionAide: Kobi always stays visible beside it.
reglages.affichage.delaiAide: Once the answer is done; Esc or a click outside puts it away right away.
reglages.affichage.etatAide: The little word under Kobi while it works; there’s none when idle or in a meeting.
reglages.affichage.etatNonDetail: Just Kobi, its face says it all.

{notes}
coque.voix.parleReunion: OK, I'll answer out loud during the meeting.
coque.voix.ecritReunion: OK, in meetings I'll answer in writing.
coque.rappels.rappelNote: Got it: I'll remind you {quand} to {texte}.
coque.interpellation.nemotronIntrouvable: Nemotron model not found: put the sherpa-onnx-nemotron-… package in ~/Kobi/models
coque.ecrivain.dossierImpossible: I can't create the meeting folder: {erreur}
coque.ecrivain.fichiersManquants: Summary not saved: the meeting files are missing.
coque.pannes.patience: On it, I'll let you know as soon as it's ready.
coque.pannes.relance: Claude stopped, I'm restarting it and asking your question again.
coque.pannes.limiteMessage: Your Claude account has reached its usage limit{jusquA}. Try again later, or upgrade your plan. {suite}
coque.pannes.deconnecteMessage: Open a terminal and run `claude auth login`, then ask your question again. {suite}
coque.pannes.absentMessage: Install Claude Code (claude.ai/code) or check that it starts in a terminal, then ask your question again. {suite}
coque.pannes.horsLigneMessage: I'm keeping your question and will ask it as soon as the connection is back. {suite}
coque.pannes.lenteurMessage: Nothing for {duree}: I'm dropping this question. Ask it again in a moment. {suite}
coque.pannes.dureeMaxMessage: It hit the maximum duration{duree}: I'm stopping it. Split up the request, or raise “taches.duree_max_s” in the settings. {suite}
coque.pannes.plantageMessage: It stopped twice in a row on this question. Ask it again in a moment. {suite}
coque.carnet.reunionEnCours: This meeting is in progress: end it before deleting it.
coque.demarrage.indisponible: starting with the system is unavailable
coque.raccourci.dejaUtilise: {nouveau} is already taken, by another app or another Kobi shortcut: {ancien} stays the shortcut ({erreur}).
coque.langue.configIllisible: config.toml can't be read, language not saved: {probleme}
coque.mcp.coffreRefuse: The system's credential manager is refusing access: Kobi can't store this secret there, and never writes it to disk in plain text. {marche}
coque.mcp.coffreLinux: On Linux, Kobi goes through Secret Service: start your session keyring (gnome-keyring or KWallet) and unlock it, then try again.
coque.mcp.coffreMacos: Unlock your login keychain (Keychain Access app), then try again.
coque.mcp.coffreWindows: Check that Windows Credential Manager is working (the “Credential Manager” service), then try again.
coque.mcp.secretNonRange: Nothing imported: the secret {cle} of “{nom}” couldn't be stored. {erreur}
coque.mcp.sseNonTestable: Kobi can't test an SSE server yet: its tools stay classed as writing.
coque.mcp.autorisationDemandee: This server needs you to sign in. Claude Code may already have access; to read the tool list and know which ones only read, Kobi needs its own authorization.
coque.mcp.pasDeConnexion: no sign-in in the browser within 5 min
coque.mcp.pasUnePageWeb: authorization address refused: it isn't a web page
coque.mcp.commandeVide: enter the command that starts the server
coque.mcp.pageFin: All set, Kobi can read this server's tools. You can close this tab.
coque.controle.refuse: {commande}: declined by the user, nothing was done
coque.controle.delai: {commande}: no answer within {s} s, declined, nothing was done
coque.controle.texteSeul: Kobi answers in text only here: kobi config set voice.assistant true (or voice.meeting in a meeting)
coque.controle.sansExecution: command not run by the app: {commande}
coque.controle.sectionIllisible: unreadable panel or meeting: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores only

session.config.syntaxe: {chemin}: syntax error or invalid value, using defaults. {erreur}
session.config.serialiser: settings can't be written as TOML: {erreur}
session.config.fpsMot: “{mot}”: a number of frames per second or "ecran"
session.cles.hotkey_record: Shortcut that starts or stops recording (Ctrl+Shift+R).
session.cles.hotkey_write: Shortcut that opens the bubble to write to Kobi (Ctrl+Alt+K).
session.cles.hotkey_view: Shortcut that opens or tucks away the large conversation view (Ctrl+Alt+G).
session.cles.codebases: Code folders Kobi can read (full paths).
session.cles.audio.sources: Computer sound in meetings (other people's voices on video calls): mic (microphone only, default) or both.
session.cles.audio.sortie: Audio output captured for the computer sound; empty: the system's.
session.cles.notes.interval_min: Interval for block notes, 1 to 10 minutes.
session.cles.taches.abandon_s: A Claude task with no sign of life (no text, no tool running, no card waiting) is dropped after this delay, 30 to 3600 seconds (300 by default).
session.cles.taches.duree_max_s: Maximum duration of a Claude task, even an active one, 60 to 7200 seconds (900 by default).
session.cles.voice.verbosite: How much Kobi talks: bavard (chatty), normal (default) or discret (quiet).
session.cles.meetings.titre_auto: Meeting title given by Kobi from what is said at the start.
session.cles.stockage.dossier: Folder for meetings, conversations and reminders (null: ~/Kobi).
session.cles.stockage.publication.reunio: MCP server to publish summaries to.
Where to publish summaries on that server.
session.cles.stockage.publication.conver: MCP server to publish conversations to.
Where to publish conversations on that server.
session.cles.permissions.fichier: Writing files: demander (ask, default) or sans_demander (don't ask).
session.cles.permissions.commande: Commands that change things: demander (ask, default) or sans_demander (don't ask).
session.cles.animations.fps: Animation frames per second: 5, 15, 30, 60 (default), 120 or "ecran" (screen refresh rate).
session.cles.animations.economie: Power saving: when idle for a long time, the mascot slows down to 3 then 2 frames/s (off by default).
session.cles.permissions.reglage: Changes to Kobi's settings: demander (ask, default) or sans_demander (don't ask).
ctl.commandes.status: Kobi's state: session, mascot, current meeting, listening, window.
ctl.commandes.appOpen: Opens the Kobi app on a section (notes and meetings, reminders, activity, settings, about, home).
ctl.commandes.appOpen.reunion: Meeting to open in the notes (its name, see “meetings list”).
ctl.commandes.mascotHide: Hides the mascot (Kobi stays in the system tray).
ctl.commandes.mascotDiscreet: Discreet mode: the mascot shrinks to a small dot, or comes back.
ctl.commandes.viewOpen: Opens the conversation full size on screen (enlarged view).
ctl.commandes.viewToggle: Opens or closes the enlarged conversation view.
ctl.commandes.configGet: Reads a setting (dotted key, for example “voice.assistant”), or all settings.
ctl.commandes.configList: Lists the settings: key, value, applied live or on restart, description.
ctl.commandes.configSet: Changes a setting: value checked, written to config.toml, applied live when possible.
ctl.commandes.meetingStop: Ends the meeting; the summary is written afterwards.
ctl.commandes.meetingRename: Gives the current meeting a title (or a past meeting with --id); Kobi won't replace it anymore.
ctl.commandes.meetingRename.id: Past meeting (its Notebook folder); otherwise the current meeting.
ctl.commandes.meetingStatus: State of the current meeting: active, paused, start, duration, number of notes, last note.
ctl.commandes.meetingsList: Lists recorded meetings, most recent first.
ctl.commandes.meetingsGet: Reads a meeting: summary, notes, transcript, or everything.
ctl.commandes.meetingsGet.id: Meeting name (its Notebook folder), or “last” for the most recent one.
ctl.commandes.notesLast: Notes and summary of the last meeting.
ctl.commandes.meetingsExport: Exports a meeting as Markdown (title and full text).
ctl.commandes.meetingsExport.id: Meeting name (its Notebook folder), or “last” for the most recent one.
ctl.commandes.search: Searches for a word in meetings (transcript, notes, summary) and conversations.
ctl.commandes.conversationsList: Lists everyday conversations, most recent first.
ctl.commandes.conversationsGet.id: Identifier, or “last” for the most recent one.
ctl.commandes.remindersAdd: Adds a reminder or a to-do.
ctl.commandes.remindersAdd.due: Due date: RFC 3339 date (2026-10-19T09:00:00+02:00) or Unix ms.
ctl.commandes.listenPause: Pauses listening: microphone off, no more transcription.
ctl.commandes.voiceSay: Kobi says a text out loud.
ctl.commandes.validationAsk: Asks the user to approve a tool call that writes (card, yes or no, refused after 60 s); answers accepte: true or false.
ctl.commandes.validationAsk.input: Tool input, as the agent sent it.
ctl.commandes.parametresObjet: parameters must be a JSON object
